_README: Sheet wording -> the strings this app actually exposes in the XML dump.
Only labels that CANNOT match on their own belong here. 'Flash Auto',
'Timer off' and 'Metering: Matrix' already reach BACK_FLASH_AUTO,
BACK_TIMER_OFF and EXPOSURE_METERING_MATRIX by ordinary word overlap, and
aliasing them would hide a real rename behind a hand-written answer.
on_screen is a LIST of alternatives: any one matching is a match. This is
how one sheet label covers screens that name the same option differently.
confirmed:false entries are ignored at load time. Set it true only after
seeing the target on the device.

Both '12M' and '12MP' appear across sheet versions. Alias keys are exact strings, so a spelling that is not listed simply does not fire -- which reads as a missing control, not as a missing alias. Add the variant.
_device: Samsung camera (com.sec.android.app.camera), verified on S25 Ultra. Expect the families to hold on other Samsung models; check the 'why: inferred' entries against a fresh dump before trusting them.
